Brand.name: VideoBrief
Brand.tagline: Personalized YouTube summaries, synced to the video.

Landing.headline: Turn any video into sections you can follow
Landing.subtitle: Paste a YouTube link. Preview, set prefs, and get a sectioned summary synced as you watch.

Auth.loginSubtitle: Pick up where you left off in your library.
Auth.signupSubtitle: Paste a video link and follow along in sections.
Auth.softConfirm: You can start using VideoBrief right away. Check your email to confirm when you can.

Onboarding.title: Default summary style
Onboarding.subtitle: Optional defaults for tone and length. Skip anytime — you can change them per video.
Onboarding.optionalHint: Every field is optional. Skip uses Formal/Casual and Short/Long midpoints (50).

Library.empty: No videos yet. Paste a YouTube link above to get started.
Library.pasteHint: English captions required. Preview loads metadata only — Generate starts analysis.

Library.usageUnavailable: Couldn't check your usage limit. Try again in a moment.
Library.deleteConfirm: Remove “{title}” from your library? You can add it again later.
Library.familiarityLabel: How familiar are you with this topic?
